title: Nawab Kapoor Singh’s Lahore Exploit and the Opening of Episode 91

blocks.text: Kapoor Singh decides that he too should perform a deed of daring and rides out with a small mounted party toward Lahore. He reaches the city, occupies a prominent central place for a time, and turns the excursion into a public display of confidence that unsettles the Mughal authorities.

News quickly reaches the officials of Lahore, who send Khizar Khan to capture him. Kapoor Singh withdraws before they can close in, and the action becomes another example of how the Khalsa can transform audacity into political theater while remaining difficult to pin down by force.

The page then widens back out to the unstable truce, noting that delayed payments still led to renewed raiding. From there it explicitly turns the narrative hinge: Now follows the episode of Jassa Singh, opening Episode 91 with the rise of a man who begins in poverty and joins the Khalsa.
